summary: Generated email send commands print the request instead of delivering unless --send is given; --sandbox runs with Postmark's test token.
reason: An agent or a copied example could deliver real email by accident. The gate wraps send, send-with-template, send-batch, send-batch-with-templates, and send-bulk, and the transport refuses delivering POSTs unless the gate allowed them.
validated_outcome: TestEmailSendPreviewsWithoutSendFlag and TestSendGateCoversEveryDeliveringCommand pass; no POST /email reaches the server without --send.
